section: A. Brand voice & competitor monitoring / 品牌声量与竞品监测

googleTrends.source: Google Trends (RELATIVE index 0-100, not absolute volume)
googleTrends.note: Run scripts/fetch_google_trends.py once keywords are confirmed. Each entry: { market, current, prevWeek, wow, yoy, peakDate, series[] }.

appStore.note: Run scripts/fetch_appstore.py once the iOS appId is confirmed. Each entry: { market, rank, rating, ratingCount, version, versionDate, prevRating, prevRatingCount }. Mark rank as a gap if not stably obtainable.

competitorComparison.note: Populated only after Patrick confirms the competitor list. Each entry: { competitor, market, metric, thisWeek, prevWeek, wow, fourWeekTrend[], relativeMove, likelyCause, hypothesisToVerify }.
